original.statement: In Flux 2.7.0, `flux push artifact --provider azure` is allowed to call the Azure CLI when it runs on Azure DevOps runners.

decision.reason: [ev-b4b297bb4480] names the exact command and flag (`flux push artifact --provider azure`) and describes a fix that changes runtime semantics (Azure CLI calls are now allowed on DevOps runners) without adding, removing or re-defaulting the flag, so cli-flag --provider scoped to the `flux push artifact` command with behavior-changed matches the text.
